info.title: Zolai Grammar-Aware Training Data
info.description: 60K+ grammar-aware training examples for Tedim Zolai language models. Includes Qwen3 chat format (9,386 examples), negation exercises (26,061), question exercises (24,738), conditional exercises (284), and seed data (500 pairs). All examples enforce ZVS 2018 orthography, SOV word order, and proper negation/question patterns.
